name: Online Business Builders
_paletteSource: Rebuilt from the OBB logo: a deep navy field (#0F1829), white wordmark, and the blue-gradient accent (#3B82F6). On a near-black navy the accent and status colors read cleanly as both fills and text, so the board no longer needs the mid-tone workarounds the old slate required.

_tokenGuide.ink: page background, deep navy from the logo
_tokenGuide.ink2: card and panel background, one step lighter so cards lift off the page
_tokenGuide.ink3: raised surfaces: table header rows, active chips, hover states
_tokenGuide.inkDeep: recessed wells: the data-quality strip backing, inset charts, code blocks
_tokenGuide.accent: the logo blue. Button and bar fills, active chip fills, chart lines, focus rings, with white text on top
_tokenGuide.accentText: accent-colored TEXT on ink or ink2 (a lighter blue so it clears contrast on the dark navy)
_tokenGuide.accentDeep: pressed and hover states, and the darker stop of the bar gradient
_tokenGuide.accent2: second data series in charts. Amber, distinct from the blue
_tokenGuide.good / warn / alert: solid status colors for filled chips and bars with white text
_tokenGuide.goodText / warnText / alertText: brighter tints for status-colored TEXT on the dark navy

_contrastRule: On the deep navy background every tint clears 4.5:1 as text, so status can be carried by either a filled chip (solid color, white text) or the *Text tint directly. The board keeps filled chips for emphasis (data-quality strip, insight severity) and uses the *Text tints for table cells and sparklines. Never use the solid accent as text on ink; use accentText.
_fontNote: Switched headings from a serif to Inter to match the logo's geometric sans and read as a modern data tool. If OBB has a brand typeface, swap head and body here, self-host under assets/fonts/, and drop googleImport.
_rules: Rebranding is a token swap in this file only. Never hard-code a color in index.html.
Never use accent #3B82F6 as text on ink or ink2. Use accentText.
Status colors are semantic. Do not reuse the accent for a status, and do not reuse a status color for a brand element.
No em dashes or en dashes in any board copy. Use commas, colons, or parentheses.
